title: Safar iyo fasax
description: Ten short, simple stories about travel and holidays in Somali towns, the countryside and abroad: twins planning a trip to Djibouti, a muddy lorry ride to Ceerigaabo, a lake in Kenya, the dry season with a grandfather, a brave girl and a snake, a hotel in Berbera, the old slave market in Zanzibar, an Eid gift in Jigjiga, a cup of tea in Rome and a lost bag at the airport.

lessons.title: Qaamuuska Huda
lessons.summary: The twins Hibaaq and Huda in Hargeysa plan a trip to their aunt in Djibouti; on Thursday they make a list and check everything, Huda wants to take a French dictionary, and at the airport on Saturday she thinks she forgot it, but Hibaaq had packed it.
lessons.text:
Hibaaq iyo Huda waa mataan. Waxay jiraan labaatan sano, waxayna la nool yihiin hooyadood Shamis magaalada Hargeysa. Walaasha hooyadood, Saciido, waxay ku nooshahay Jabuuti.

Xagaagan, mataantu waxay rabaan inay u safraan Jabuuti. Waxay weydiiyeen hooyadood.

"Haye," ayay tidhi Shamis. "Idinka waxaad tihiin gabdho waaweyn. Qorsheynta safarka waa idinka."

"Haye, hooyo," ayay tidhi Hibaaq.

Maanta waa khamiis. Diyaaraddu waxay baxaysaa sabtida. Khamiista, mataantu waxay fadhiisteen miiska, waxayna bilaabeen qorsheynta. Hibaaq waxay warqad ku qortay waxa ay u baahan yihiin: lacagta, dharka iyo shandadaha.

"Jabuuti dad badan ayaa ku hadla Af Faransiis," ayay tidhi Huda. "Aniga Af Faransiis ma aqaan. Qaamuus ayaan qaadan doonaa." Hibaaq waxay warqadda ku qortay: "Qaamuuska Huda."

"Ogow, Huda," ayay tidhi Hibaaq. "Qorsheyntu waa muhiim. Wax walba hubso."

"Haye," ayay tidhi Huda. Huda waxay hubsatay lacagteeda iyo dharkeeda. Hibaaq waxay hubsatay waqtiga diyaaradda. Habeenkii, labaduba waxay hubsadeen shandadaha.

Sabtida subax hore, Shamis iyo mataantu waxay tageen meesha diyaaradaha. Huda waxay eegtay shandaddeeda yar. Qaamuuskii kuma jirin.

"Hooyo! Qaamuuskii waan hilmaamay!" ayay tidhi Huda. "Qorsheyn badan ayaan samaynay, laakiin qaamuuskii waan hilmaamay."

Hibaaq way qososhay. "Ogow, Huda. Qaamuuskaagu wuxuu ku jiraa shandaddayda. Xalay ayaan hubsaday."

Shamis way qososhay. "Idinka labadiinuba waa mataan," ayay tidhi, "laakiin Hibaaq waxba ma hilmaanto."

Diyaaraddu way baxday. Saacad kadib, mataantu waxay gaadheen Jabuuti. Saciido ayaa sugaysay. "Ogow, Huda," ayay tidhi Hibaaq, "hadda qaamuuskaaga ayaad u baahan tahay." Huda waxay qaadatay qaamuuskeeda, waxayna bilowday inay ku hadasho Af Faransiis.

Su'aalo:
Mataantu meeshee bay u safrayaan?
Mataantu waxay u safrayaan Jabuuti.
Mataantu goorma ayay bilaabeen qorsheynta?
Mataantu waxay bilaabeen qorsheynta khamiista.
Diyaaraddu goorma ayay baxaysaa?
Diyaaraddu waxay baxaysaa sabtida.
Huda maxay hilmaantay?
Huda waxay moodday inay hilmaantay qaamuuskeeda.
Qaamuusku meeshee buu ku jiray?
Qaamuusku wuxuu ku jiray shandadda Hibaaq.

lessons.title: Baabuurka iyo dhoobada
lessons.summary: In the autumn rainy season Cabdiqaadir takes the cheap lorry from Burco to his parents in Ceerigaabo; the driver speeds up on the empty road, a tyre bursts in the mud after the rain, the men push, and he arrives wet and dirty.
lessons.text:
Cabdiqaadir waa nin dhallinyar ah oo ka shaqeeya Burco. Waalidkiis waxay ku nool yihiin Ceerigaabo. Xilliga dayrta, Cabdiqaadir wuxuu rabaa inuu u safro Ceerigaabo.

Diyaaraddu way qaali tahay, laakiin baabuurka weyn ee dadka qaada ayaa jaban. "Safar jaban ayaan rabaa," ayuu yidhi Cabdiqaadir. Wuxuu bixiyay lacag yar, waayo safarka baabuurku waa jaban yahay.

Dayrtu waa xilliga roobka. Dayrta roob badan ayaa yimaada. Subaxdii, Cabdiqaadir wuxuu eegay cirka. Daruuro madow ayaa cirka ku jiray. "Daruurahan roob bay keeni doonaan," ayuu yidhi nin kale oo baabuurka sugayay.

Baabuurku wuxuu ka baxay Burco. Waddadu madhan bay ahayd. Gaari kale ma jirin. "Waddadu waa madhan tahay," ayuu yidhi ninka baabuurka wada. Kadib wuu dardaray. Baabuurku waddada madhan si degdeg ah ayuu ugu socday. Mar kale ayuu dardaray.

Galabtii, daruuraha ayaa cirka oo dhan buuxiyay, roob weyn ayaana yimid. Waddadu waxay noqotay dhoobo. Ninka baabuurka wadaa mar kale wuu dardaray. Kadib taayirka baabuurka ayaa dillaacay. Baabuurku wuu istaagay, dhoobada dhexdeeda.

"Taayirku wuu dillaacay," ayuu yidhi ninkii baabuurka waday. "I caawiya."

Cabdiqaadir iyo rag kale ayaa baabuurka ka soo baxay. Roobku wuxuu qoyay dharkooda. Waxay riixeen baabuurka. Dhoobadu waxay ku dhacday lugahooda iyo dharkooda. Ninkii wuxuu beddelay taayirka dillaacay.

"Xagee baynu joognaa?" ayuu weydiiyay Cabdiqaadir.

"Ceerigaabo way dhow tahay," ayuu yidhi ninkii.

Habeenkii, baabuurku wuxuu gaadhay Ceerigaabo. Cabdiqaadir wuxuu tagay guriga waalidkiis. Hooyadiis ayaa albaabka furtay.

"Xagee ayaad ka timid?" ayay tidhi, way qososhay. "Dharkaagu waa qoyan yahay, waana wasakh!"

"Hooyo, safarku waa jaban yahay, laakiin wuu adkaa," ayuu yidhi Cabdiqaadir. Hooyadiis waxay siisay dhar nadiif ah. Cabdiqaadir wuxuu dhaqay wasakhda gacmaha iyo lugaha.

Su'aalo:
Cabdiqaadir xagee buu u safray?
Cabdiqaadir wuxuu u safray Ceerigaabo.
Cabdiqaadir muxuu baabuurka u raacay?
Wuxuu baabuurka u raacay, waayo safarka baabuurku waa jaban yahay.
Subaxdii maxaa cirka ku jiray?
Subaxdii daruuro madow ayaa cirka ku jiray.
Maxaa dillaacay?
Taayirka baabuurka ayaa dillaacay.
Dharka Cabdiqaadir sidee buu ahaa?
Dharkiisu wuxuu ahaa qoyan iyo wasakh.

lessons.title: Harada Naivasha
lessons.summary: In the school holidays Muxubo takes her children Ciise and Bilan from Eastleigh to Lake Naivasha; the water sparkles, the children play and watch a big bird catch a fish, and in the evening mosquitoes come and one bites Bilan.
lessons.text:
Muxubo waxay ku nooshahay xaafadda Eastleigh ee magaalada Nairobi. Ciyaalkeedu waa Ciise iyo Bilan. Ciise wuxuu jiraa sideed sano. Bilan waxay jirtaa lix sano.

Xagaaga, Muxubo waxay ciyaalka u kaxaysay Harada Naivasha. Harada Naivasha waa haro weyn oo ku taal Kenya. Biyaha haradu waa buluug. Marka qorraxdu biyaha ku dhacdo, biyaha haradu way dhalaalayaan.

"Hooyo, eeg! Biyaha ayaa dhalaalaya!" ayuu yidhi Ciise.

Ciyaalku harada agagaarkeeda ayay ku ciyaareen. Way ordeen, way qosleen, wayna ciyaareen. Shimbiro badan ayaa harada ku noolaa. Qaar way cad yihiin, qaarna waxay leeyihiin baalal buluug ah.

Shimbir weyn oo cad ayaa biyaha ku dhacday. Markii ay soo baxday, kalluun ayaa afkeeda ku jiray. "Hooyo, shimbirtu kalluun bay qabatay!" ayay tidhi Bilan.

Nin ayaa harada kalluun ka qabanayay. Wuxuu ciyaalka tusay kalluun weyn. "Harada kalluun badan ayaa ku jira," ayuu yidhi. Muxubo waxay ka iibsatay kalluunkii, casho ahaan.

Fiidkii, qorraxdu way dhacday. Kaneeco badan ayaa timid. Kaneecadu waxay qaniintay Bilan gacanteeda. "Hooyo! Kaneeco ayaa i qaniintay!" ayay tidhi Bilan.

Muxubo waxay tidhi: "Kaneecadu dhiigga ayay nuugtaa. Marka ay qofka qaniinto, dhiiggiisa ayay nuugtaa. Mararka qaarkood cudur bay keentaa." Waxay ciyaalka u xidhay dhar dheer, kadibna dhammaantood qolka ayay galeen. Kaneecadu qolka ma soo gelin.

Subaxdii dambe, ciyaalku mar kale harada agagaarkeeda ayay ku ciyaareen. Shimbiraha ayay eegeen. Biyaha haradu mar kale way dhalaalayeen.

"Harada waan jeclahay," ayuu yidhi Ciise, "laakiin kaneecada ma jecli."

Su'aalo:
Muxubo meeshee bay ciyaalka u kaxaysay?
Muxubo waxay ciyaalka u kaxaysay Harada Naivasha.
Biyaha haradu waa maxay midabkoodu?
Biyaha haradu waa buluug.
Shimbirta weyn maxay qabatay?
Shimbirta weyn waxay qabatay kalluun.
Maxaa qaniinay Bilan?
Kaneeco ayaa qaniintay Bilan.
Kaneecadu maxay nuugtaa?
Kaneecadu waxay nuugtaa dhiigga.

lessons.title: Jiilaalka miyiga
lessons.summary: Twelve-year-old Kaamil from Muqdisho spends the holidays with his grandfather Diiriye near Beledweyne in the dry season; there is no grass, they take the donkey to the well, Diiriye explains how families grow poor, and after the rain the land turns green.
lessons.text:
Kaamil waa wiil laba iyo toban jir ah oo ku nool Muqdisho. Xagaaga, wuxuu u safray miyiga, meel u dhow Beledweyne. Halkaas waxaa ku nool Diiriye, aabbaha hooyadiis. Diiriye waa oday weyn.

Diiriye wuxuu haystaa duunyo badan: lo', ari, awr iyo dameer. "Duunyadu waa noloshayda," ayuu yidhi Diiriye. "Noloshayda oo dhan duunyo ayaan koriyay. Hooyadaa sidoo kale halkan ayaan ku koriyay."

Xilligu waa jiilaal. Jiilaalka roob ma jiro. Dhulku waa cad yahay, cawsna ma jiro. Meelna cagaar kuma jiro. Lo'da iyo arigu cunto yar bay helaan.

Subax kasta, Kaamil iyo Diiriye waxay dameerka u kaxeeyaan ceelka. Dameerku wuxuu qaadaa biyaha. Awrka ayaa sidoo kale biyo qaada. Kaamil wuxuu jecel yahay dameerka. Dameerku waa yar yahay, laakiin wuu xoog badan yahay.

"Jiilaalku waa xilli adag," ayuu yidhi Diiriye. "Jiilaalka, reer miyiga qaar way sabool noqdaan. Duunyadoodu way dhimataa, kadibna waxba ma haystaan."

"Adigu ma sabool baad tahay?" ayuu weydiiyay Kaamil.

Diiriye wuu qoslay. "Maya, sabool ma ihi. Duunyadaydu way nooshahay. Laakiin jiilaalka waxaynu sugnaa roobka."

Toddobaad kadib, daruuro madow ayaa yimid, roob weyn ayaana yimid. Saddex maalmo kadib, caws cusub ayaa dhulka ka soo baxay. Dhulku wuxuu noqday cagaar. Caws cagaaran ayaa meel walba ku yaal. Geedaha caleemo cagaaran ayaa ka soo baxay.

Lo'da, ariga iyo awrku waxay cuneen cawska cagaaran. Dameerkuna wuu cunay. Kaamil aad buu u faraxsanaa. "Cagaarka waan jeclahay!" ayuu yidhi.

"Jiilaalku wuu dhammaaday," ayuu yidhi Diiriye. "Hadda duunyadu cunto badan bay heli doontaa."

Su'aalo:
Diiriye muxuu haystaa?
Diiriye wuxuu haystaa duunyo badan: lo', ari, awr iyo dameer.
Diiriye halkan muxuu ku koriyay?
Diiriye wuxuu halkan ku koriyay duunyo iyo hooyada Kaamil.
Jiilaalka maxaa jira?
Jiilaalka roob ma jiro, cawsna ma jiro.
Dameerku muxuu qaadaa?
Dameerku wuxuu qaadaa biyaha.
Diiriye ma sabool baa?
Maya, Diiriye sabool ma aha.
Roobka kadib dhulku muxuu noqday?
Roobka kadib dhulku wuxuu noqday cagaar.

lessons.title: Ardo waa geesi
lessons.summary: In the holidays Ardo, a left-handed girl from Gaalkacyo, and her little brother Bootaan stay with their uncle in the countryside; the fire's smoke keeps animals away, they find a lion's droppings by the fence, and on the fourth night Ardo kills a snake beside her barefoot brother.
lessons.text:
Ardo waa gabadh afar iyo toban jir ah oo ku nool Gaalkacyo. Walaalkeed yar waa Bootaan. Bootaan wuxuu jiraa sagaal sano. Xagaaga, labaduba waxay u tageen adeerkood oo miyiga ku nool. Adeerkood wuxuu haystaa geel iyo riyo.

Ardo waa guray. Waxay wax ku qortaa gacanta bidix, wax walbana gacanta bidix ayay ku qabataa. Qoyskeeda, Ardo oo kaliya ayaa guray ah.

Habeen kasta, adeerkood wuxuu shidaa dab weyn. Qiiqa dabka ayaa cirka u baxa. "Xayawaanku cabsi bay ka qabaan dabka iyo qiiqa," ayuu yidhi adeerkood. "Qiiqu kaneecada sidoo kale wuu celiyaa."

Habeenkii saddexaad, Ardo waxay maqashay cod weyn oo fog. "Waa aar," ayuu yidhi adeerkood. Subaxdii, oodda agagaarkeeda waxay ku arkeen raad iyo xaar. "Waa xaarka aarka," ayuu yidhi adeerkood. "Aarku xalay wuu yimid, laakiin cabsi buu ka qabay dabka iyo qiiqa."

Habeenkii afaraad, dabku wuu yaraaday, qiiquna wuu yaraaday. Bootaan wuxuu u socday dabka agagaarkiisa. Cagaha Bootaan way qaawanaayeen. Ardo waxay aragtay mas weyn oo dhulka ku jira, meel u dhow cagaha qaawan ee Bootaan.

"Bootaan, joogso!" ayay tidhi Ardo. Bootaan wuu joogsaday, kadibna wuu dhacay. Jilibkiisa ayaa dhulka ku dhacay. Ardo waxay ul ku qabatay gacanta bidix. Maska ayay ul ku tuntay. Mar kale ayay tuntay. Maskii wuu dhintay.

Adeerkood ayaa yimid. Wuxuu arkay maska iyo jilibka Bootaan. "Ardo, adigu waa geesi!" ayuu yidhi.

Adeerkood wuxuu biyo ku dhaqay jilibka Bootaan. "Jilibkaagu xanuun weyn ma laha," ayuu yidhi. "Laakiin hadda kadib, habeenkii ha socon cagaha qaawan."

Bootaan wuu qoslay. "Walaashay waa geesi," ayuu yidhi. "Waa geesi guray ah!"

Su'aalo:
Ardo gacanta bidix ma wax ku qortaa?
Haa, Ardo waa guray, waxayna wax ku qortaa gacanta bidix.
Subaxdii maxay ku arkeen oodda agagaarkeeda?
Waxay ku arkeen raad iyo xaarka aarka.
Habeenkii afaraad Ardo maxay aragtay?
Habeenkii afaraad Ardo waxay aragtay mas weyn.
Ardo maska maxay ku tuntay?
Ardo maska waxay ku tuntay ul.
Adeerkood muxuu yidhi?
Adeerkood wuxuu yidhi: "Ardo, adigu waa geesi."

lessons.title: Hudheelka Berbera
lessons.summary: Warfaa arrives on Monday at a small hotel by the sea in Berbera; the manager Saafi welcomes him, but the bathroom is dirty, the wall is damp and a cat sleeps on his bed; he gets angry, and Saafi improves the room until he is happy.
lessons.text:
Warfaa waa nin ka shaqeeya Muqdisho. Xagaaga, wuxuu u safray Berbera si uu badda u arko. Isniinta ayuu gaadhay Berbera. Wuxuu tagay hudheel yar oo badda u dhow.

Saafi ayaa maaraysa hudheelka. Saafi waxay soo dhoweysaa qof kasta oo yimaada. Isniintaas, way soo dhoweysay Warfaa, waxayna tustay qolkiisa.

Qolku waa yar yahay. Musqusha qolka wasakh ayaa ku jirta, biyona kuma jiraan. Derbiga qolka qoyaan ayaa ku jira. Habeenkii, bisad ayaa qolka soo gashay, waxayna ku seexatay sariirta Warfaa.

Subaxdii, Warfaa wuu xanaaqay. Wuxuu u tagay Saafi. "Musqusha wasakh ayaa ku jirta, biyona ma jiraan," ayuu yidhi. "Derbigana qoyaan ayaa ku jira. Bisadna sariirtayda ayay ku seexatay!" Xanaaq ayaa codkiisa ku jiray.

"Raali ii ahow," ayay tidhi Saafi. "Maanta qolka waan wanaajin doonaa."

Saafi waxay keentay nin. Ninkii wuxuu hagaajiyay biyaha musqusha, kadibna wuu dhaqay musqusha. Kadib wuxuu doonay inuu qoyaanka ka saaro derbiga, laakiin shaqadiisu wax ma tarin. Qoyaanku derbiga wuu ku jiray.

Saafi waxay furtay albaabka si qorraxdu qolka u gasho. "Qorraxdu wax bay tari doontaa," ayay tidhi. "Qorraxdu qoyaanka way qaadi doontaa."

"Bisadda maxaa la samaynayaa?" ayuu weydiiyay Warfaa.

Saafi way qososhay. "Bisaddu waa bisadda guriga. Habeen kasta waxay soo gashaa qol kale. Caawa albaabka xidh."

Saddex maalmo kadib, qolku wuu wanaagsanaa. Musqusha biyo ayaa ku jira, wasakhna kuma jirto. Qoyaankii derbiga wuu yaraaday. Bisaddiina sariirtiisa kuma seexan. Xanaaqii Warfaa wuu tagay.

Maalintii ugu dambaysay, Warfaa wuxuu yidhi: "Saafi, qolka si fiican ayaad u wanaajisay. Hudheelka si wanaagsan ayaad u maaraysaa."

"Mahadsanid," ayay tidhi Saafi. "Sannadka dambe soo noqo. Waxaan rabaa inaan mar kale ku soo dhoweyso."

Su'aalo:
Warfaa maalintee buu gaadhay Berbera?
Warfaa wuxuu gaadhay Berbera isniinta.
Yaa maaraysa hudheelka?
Saafi ayaa maaraysa hudheelka.
Musqusha maxaa ku jiray?
Musqusha wasakh ayaa ku jirtay, biyona kuma jirin.
Maxaa sariirta Warfaa ku seexday?
Bisad ayaa sariirta Warfaa ku seexatay.
Ninku qoyaanka ma ka saaray derbiga?
Maya, ninku qoyaanka ma ka saarin. Shaqadiisu wax ma tarin.
Saafi maxay samaysay?
Saafi qolka way wanaajisay.

lessons.title: Suuqa addoonada
lessons.summary: The history teacher Cabdirashiid and his wife Yusra from Kismaayo visit the old slave market in Zanzibar at midday; the guide Juma tells them how people were sold there and how the British later colonized the island, and they agree this history must not be forgotten.
lessons.text:
Cabdirashiid waa bare ka shaqeeya dugsi ku yaal Kismaayo. Wuxuu baraa taariikhda. Xagaaga, isaga iyo xaaskiisa Yusra waxay u safreen Zanzibar. Zanzibar waa jasiirad ku taal badda, meel u dhow Tansaaniya.

Maalintii labaad, duhurkii, waxay tageen suuqii hore ee addoonada. Duhurkii kulayl badan ayaa jiray. Nin la yidhaahdo Juma ayaa meesha tusay. Juma wuxuu ku hadlay Af Ingiriis. Cabdirashiid ayaa u tarjumay Yusra.

"Jaallayaal, kaalaya," ayuu yidhi Juma. "Waqti hore, halkan waxaa lagu gadi jiray addoomo. Dad badan ayaa laga keeni jiray dalal kale, halkanna waxaa lagu gadi jiray sida xoolaha."

Juma wuxuu u kaxeeyay qol yar oo dhulka hoostiisa ku yaal. Qolku wuu mugdi ahaa. "Qolkan yar waxaa ku jiri jiray 75 addoon," ayuu yidhi Juma.

Yusra wax ma tiraabin. Cabdirashiid sidoo kale wax ma tiraabin. Muddo dheer labaduba wax ma tiraabin.

Juma wuxuu yidhi: "Sannadkii 1873, suuqa addoonada waa la xidhay. Kadib Ingiriisku wuu gumeystay Zanzibar. Zanzibar waxay noqotay kolonyo Ingiriis ah."

"Soomaaliya sidoo kale waa la gumeystay," ayuu yidhi Cabdirashiid. "Waqooyiga Soomaaliya wuxuu ahaa kolonyo, koonfurtuna waxay ahayd kolonyo kale."

"Haa," ayuu yidhi Juma. "Laakiin aadame kasta waa xor. Aadame lama gadi karo."

"Taariikhdan waa in aan la iloobin," ayuu yidhi Cabdirashiid. "Bare ahaan, ardayda dugsiga ayaan u sheegi doonaa."

"Haa, ha la iloobin," ayay tidhi Yusra.

"Jaalle Juma, mahadsanid," ayuu yidhi Cabdirashiid. "Juma waa jaalle fiican," ayay tidhi Yusra.

Galabtii, Cabdirashiid iyo Yusra waxay fadhiisteen xeebta. Muddo way fadhiyeen. Kadib Cabdirashiid wuxuu yidhi: "Waxaan ahay bare, waxaana baraa taariikhda. Laakiin maanta aniga ayaa wax bartay."

Su'aalo:
Cabdirashiid shaqadiisu waa maxay?
Cabdirashiid waa bare, wuxuuna baraa taariikhda.
Duhurkii meeshee bay tageen?
Duhurkii waxay tageen suuqii hore ee addoonada.
Waqti hore halkan maxaa lagu gadi jiray?
Waqti hore halkan waxaa lagu gadi jiray addoomo.
Yaa gumeystay Zanzibar?
Ingiriiska ayaa gumeystay Zanzibar.
Juma muxuu ka yidhi aadamaha?
Juma wuxuu yidhi: "Aadame kasta waa xor."
Cabdirashiid muxuu yidhi?
Cabdirashiid wuxuu yidhi: "Taariikhdan waa in aan la iloobin."

lessons.title: Hadiyadda Kiin
lessons.summary: Shy Rashiid comes from London to Jigjiga for the Eid holiday to see Kiin, the girl he is courting; at the market he buys her a piece of red cloth and a bag of soft camel leather, and when he gives them to her both of them blush.
lessons.text:
Rashiid waa nin dhallinyar ah oo ku nool London. Ciidda, wuxuu u safray Jigjiga, magaalada uu ku dhashay. Jigjiga waxaa ku nool Kiin, gabadh uu jecel yahay. Rashiid iyo Kiin waxay ku jiraan shukaansi. Shukaansigoodu wuxuu bilaabay laba sano ka hor, laakiin inta badan telefoonka ayay ku hadlaan.

Rashiid waa nin xishood badan. Marka uu arko Kiin, xishood ayaa ku dhaca, wax badanna ma odhan karo.

Rashiid wuxuu rabaa inuu Kiin siiyo hadiyad qurxoon. Wuxuu tagay suuqa weyn ee Jigjiga. Suuqa waxaa yaal dhar badan oo qurxoon, dahab iyo waxyaabo laga sameeyay saanta geela iyo lo'da.

Iibiyaha ayaa tusay dhar guduudan. "Dharkan guduudan waa kan ugu qurxoon suuqa," ayuu yidhi ninkii. Kadib wuxuu tusay boorso yar oo saan geel ah. "Saantani waa jilicsan tahay," ayuu yidhi.

Rashiid wuxuu taabtay saanta. Way jilicsanayd. "Laba xabbo ayaan rabaa," ayuu yidhi. "Hal xabbo oo dhar guduudan ah iyo hal xabbo oo boorso saan ah."

Ninkii wuu qoslay. "Hadiyad ma tahay?" ayuu weydiiyay.

"Haa, waa hadiyad," ayuu yidhi Rashiid. Casaan ayaa wajigiisa ka muuqatay.

Fiidkii, Rashiid wuxuu tagay guriga qoyska Kiin. Wuxuu Kiin siiyay labada xabbo. "Kan waa hadiyad," ayuu yidhi. Xishood darteed, wax kale ma uusan odhan.

Kiin waxay furtay hadiyadda. Waxay aragtay dharka guduudan iyo boorsada saanta ah. "Aad bay u qurxoon yihiin!" ayay tidhi. Casaan ayaa wajigeeda ka muuqatay. Kiin sidoo kale xishood ayaa ku dhacay.

Hooyada Kiin way qososhay. "Labadiinuba xishood badan baad leedihiin," ayay tidhi. "Laakiin shukaansigiinu waa wanaagsan yahay."

Su'aalo:
Rashiid meeshee buu u safray?
Rashiid wuxuu u safray Jigjiga.
Rashiid ma nin xishood badan baa?
Haa, Rashiid waa nin xishood badan.
Rashiid suuqa muxuu ka iibsaday?
Rashiid wuxuu iibsaday laba xabbo: dhar guduudan iyo boorso saan ah.
Boorsada saanta ahi ma jilicsanayd?
Haa, saantu way jilicsanayd.
Maxaa wajiga Kiin ka muuqday?
Casaan ayaa wajiga Kiin ka muuqatay.

lessons.title: Shaaha Rooma
lessons.summary: On holiday in Rome, Shirwac from Toronto turns down wine and asks for tea; the steaming tea without sugar burns his tongue and tastes bitter, so he eats bread and vegetables, adds sugar and waits for the steam to go.
lessons.text:
Shirwac waa nin ku nool Toronto. Xagaaga, wuxuu u safray Rooma, magaalo weyn oo taariikh dheer leh.

Duhurkii, Shirwac wuxuu galay meel yar oo cunto lagu iibiyo. Nin la yidhaahdo Marco ayaa u yimid. Marco wuxuu ku hadlay Af Ingiriis. "Khamri ma rabtaa?" ayuu weydiiyay.

"Maya, mahadsanid. Khamri ma cabbo," ayuu yidhi Shirwac. "Cabitaan kale ii keen."

Marco wuxuu keenay cabitaanno kala duwan: biyo, caano iyo cabitaan macaan. Shirwac wuxuu yidhi: "Cabitaankan macaan sonkor badan ayuu leeyahay. Shaah ma haysaan?"

"Haa, shaah waan haynaa," ayuu yidhi Marco.

Marco wuxuu keenay koob shaah ah. Uumi ayaa ka baxayay koobka. Shaahu aad buu u kululaa. Shirwac si degdeg ah ayuu u cabbay, carrabkiisuna wuu gubtay. "Carrabkaygii!" ayuu yidhi.

Kadib wuxuu shaaha cabbay mar kale. Shaahu bilaa sonkor buu ahaa. Shaah bilaa sonkor ah wuu qadhaadh yahay. "Shaahan waa qadhaadh yahay," ayuu yidhi Shirwac. "Sonkor ma haysaan?"

Marco wuxuu keenay sonkor. Shirwac sonkor badan ayuu shaaha ku daray.

Shirwac sidoo kale wuxuu dalbaday rooti iyo khudaar. Rootigu wuu kululaa, wuuna jilicsanaa. Khudaartu waxay ahayd cagaaran iyo casaan. Shirwac rootiga iyo khudaarta wuu cunay. Hilib ma jirin, laakiin khudaartu way wanaagsanayd.

Kadib Shirwac wuxuu dalbaday koob kale oo shaah ah. Koobkan kale sidoo kale uumi badan ayaa ka baxayay. Markan, Shirwac wuu sugay ilaa uumigu ka dhammaado. Kadib sonkor ayuu ku daray, wuuna cabbay. Shaahu ma qadhaadhayn, carrabkiisuna xanuun ma dareemin.

"Rooma waan jeclahay," ayuu yidhi Shirwac. "Laakiin shaah bilaa sonkor ah ma jecli."

Su'aalo:
Shirwac khamri ma cabbay?
Maya, Shirwac khamri ma cabbin.
Maxaa koobka shaaha ka baxayay?
Uumi ayaa koobka shaaha ka baxayay.
Maxaa gubtay markii Shirwac shaaha cabbay?
Carrabkiisa ayaa gubtay.
Shaahu muxuu qadhaadh u ahaa?
Shaahu wuu qadhaadhaa, waayo wuxuu ahaa bilaa sonkor.
Shirwac muxuu cunay?
Shirwac wuxuu cunay rooti iyo khudaar.

lessons.title: Xaashi iyo gabadhiisa
lessons.summary: Sixty-year-old Xaashi, who cannot walk, flies from Nairobi to Muqdisho with his daughter Nasteexo to see his sick sister; at the airport they look for gate thirty, Nasteexo thinks her bag with the passports is lost and calls herself a fool, but it hangs on the back of her father's chair.
lessons.text:
Xaashi waa oday lixdan sano jira. Xaashi waa naafo. Lugaha Xaashi ma shaqeeyaan, sidaas darteed wuxuu ku fadhiyaa kursi. Xaashi iyo gabadhiisa Nasteexo waxay ku nool yihiin Nairobi.

Walaasha Xaashi waxay ku nooshahay Muqdisho. Way jiran tahay. Xaashi wuxuu rabaa inuu arko walaashiis jiran. Sidaas darteed, isaga iyo Nasteexo waxay u safrayaan Muqdisho.

Subaxdii, waxay tageen meesha diyaaradaha. Nasteexo ayaa riixaysay kursiga aabbaheed. Diyaaraddu waxay ka baxaysaa albaabka soddon, konton daqiiqadood kadib. "Konton daqiiqadood ayaynu haynaa," ayuu yidhi Xaashi.

"Albaabka soddon xaggee buu yaal?" ayuu weydiiyay Xaashi. "Waan ogahay, naafo ahaan si degdeg ah uma socon karo."

Nasteexo waxay weydiisay naag halkaas ka shaqaysa. "Albaabka soddon halkee buu ku yaal? Intee buu u jiraa?"

"Waa meel dhow," ayay tidhi naagtii. "Shan daqiiqadood ayaad ku gaadhi doontaan. Naafada meel gaar ah ayay ka galaan diyaaradda."

Kadib Nasteexo way joogsatay. "Aabbe! Boorsadaydii way luntay!" ayay tidhi. "Baasaboorradu boorsada ayay ku jiraan!"

Nasteexo meel walba way eegtay. "Xaggee baan dhigay? Halkee bay ku jirtaa?" ayay tidhi. "Doqon baan ahay!"

"Doqon ma tihid," ayuu yidhi Xaashi. "Naso." Kadib Xaashi wuxuu eegay kursigiisa gadaashiisa. Boorsadu halkaas ayay ku jirtay.

"Nasteexo, boorsadaadu ma luntay? Maya," ayuu yidhi Xaashi. "Halkan bay ku jirtaa, kursigayga gadaashiisa."

Nasteexo way qososhay. "Waan dhigay, kadibna waan hilmaamay. Doqon baan ahay."

"Maya," ayuu yidhi Xaashi. "Gabadhaydu doqon ma aha. Safarku waa adag yahay."

Waxay tageen albaabka soddon. Konton daqiiqadood kadib, diyaaraddu way baxday. Galabtii, waxay gaadheen Muqdisho. Walaasha Xaashi weli way jiran tahay, laakiin markii ay aragtay walaalkeed, aad bay u faraxsanayd. "Lixdan jir baad tahay, laakiin weli waxaad tahay walaalkay yar," ayay tidhi.

Su'aalo:
Xaashi da'diisu waa intee?
Xaashi wuxuu jiraa lixdan sano.
Xaashi iyo Nasteexo maxay Muqdisho ugu safrayaan?
Waayo walaasha Xaashi way jiran tahay.
Albaabka soddon intee buu u jiraa?
Albaabka soddon waa meel dhow.
Diyaaraddu xaggee bay ka baxaysaa?
Diyaaraddu waxay ka baxaysaa albaabka soddon.
Nasteexo maxay moodday?
Nasteexo waxay moodday in boorsadeedu luntay.
Boorsadu halkee bay ku jirtay?
Boorsadu waxay ku jirtay kursiga Xaashi gadaashiisa.
